notes.title: Score Ratings Fix
notes.content:
Happy New Years!

Fixed: Score ratings not showing correctly.
Added: More words to the Disorder game mode.
Various bug / crash fixes

My apologies for the delay on this patch. My last update had changed how the score ratings were assigned and the "Fix" actually created another bug which I have now patched so scores will be showing correctly now.

I have also added more words to the registry for the Disorder game mode as well as various bug / crash fixes.

Huge thank you to everyone who has purchased my game and especially to everyone who has left their feedback / review for the game. the last 2 weeks has been a really awesome experience!

Cheers!
Stonie.
